notes.title: Update 12 Jule
notes.content: Fixed minor bugs and added the ability to disable voice chat in-game to prevent audio stuttering and improve user experience.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content: Gameplay has been improved to make it more dynamic, 7 bugs have been fixed — both major and minor, and Chinese language support has been added.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Accelerated event progression for more dynamic gameplay.   
 
Fixed a lighting bug for consistent illumination.   
 
Resolved an issue with the cart that allowed players to exit the game area. 

Thank you for your feedback, we continue to work on improvements!

notes.title: Update: Download issue has been fixed!
notes.content:
We’re happy to announce that the technical issue preventing the game from downloading has been resolved. If you’re still experiencing any problems, please contact us at dd.tunnel.game@gmail.com — we’ll be glad to help!

Thanks for your support and patience

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
We welcome two new languages to the game — English and Spanish. Now, the interface and texts are available for users who speak these languages.

This update also includes many bug fixes that were affecting the gameplay. Additionally, subtitles have been added to some in-game texts to improve readability and make it easier to follow the content.

Thank you to all the testers — your support is a big help in improving the game.
